message.subject: Showroom idea for Flowery Branch facility
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Congrats on the new Flowery Branch showroom—expanding the customer experience space is a smart move, especially with how active you've been at ISA and PRINTING United.

I wanted to reach out because we work with printer manufacturers looking to demonstrate outdoor durability in a more tangible way. Our protective film has a unique feature: spray paint and permanent marker wipe clean in seconds. It's become a powerful demo piece for showrooms and trade show booths.

Given Mimaki's focus on outdoor graphics and vehicle wraps, this might be worth exploring for your facility. Would you be open to a quick call to discuss how others are using this as a differentiation tool?

Best,
[Your name]
